title: Expose changed definitions and keep commands inert
preconditions: A separate case has implementation evidence; record a legacy failed run whose command would create a marker file if executed.

steps.action: Read the definition and history after recording the command; inspect the marker path.
steps.expected_result: The definition remains linked, history retains failed as metadata, and the marker does not exist.

steps.action: Revise the case definition while retaining old evidence, then inspect the query and reader.
steps.expected_result: The evidence and step mapping report staleness with the test-revision-changed reason.

expected_result: Expose changed definitions and keep commands inert.
